method.label: Locate the median by cumulative counts

annotationRationale: The median definition identifies the two required positions, and arithmetic-series sums locate them within the repeated values.
sourceMethod: Followed the official cumulative-count solution, using the exact counts through 141 and 142 to identify both middle entries.

review.mathCheck: There are \(20{,}100\) entries. Since the cumulative counts through 141 and 142 are \(10{,}011\) and \(10{,}153\), respectively, both positions \(10{,}050\) and \(10{,}051\) contain 142. The median is 142, choice C.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution #16 on slot 2. It retains the cumulative-count threshold argument; the omitted root estimate is unnecessary once the exact bounds are verified.
review.annotationCheck: The even-size median rule and inclusive position range are correct and explicit. The explanation is sufficient for an AMC 12 student.
